charter: Find defects that make the change set slow, unbounded, or crashy under load, when a dependency fails, or during deploy/restart.

inputs.summary: Review fanout_worker for load and dependency failure.

issues.title: Module-level results list is unbounded
issues.whats_wrong: _RESULTS appends every partner payload and fanout returns that growing list.
issues.why_it_matters: Under traffic the process holds every historical body in memory until OOM.
how_to_fix: Return a local list for this call only.
If a cache is required, bound it and evict.
acceptance_criteria: A second fanout call does not include the first call's payloads.
issues.do_not_change: JSON decode of a successful body.

issues.title: httpx.get has no timeout
issues.whats_wrong: httpx.get(url) uses the client default, so a hung partner blocks the worker.
issues.why_it_matters: One silent partner stalls the whole fanout under load.
how_to_fix: Pass a finite timeout= to get, matching other HTTP helpers in the repo.
acceptance_criteria: Every partner GET uses an explicit timeout.

issues.title: Partner failures are swallowed
issues.whats_wrong: except Exception: pass hides timeouts, 5xx, and decode errors.
issues.why_it_matters: A broken dependency looks like an empty success; operators cannot page.
how_to_fix: Catch httpx.HTTPError (or equivalent) and record the failed URL.
acceptance_criteria: A failing URL is visible in the return value or a raised error; it is not silent.

issues.title: shutdown does not drain in-flight fetches
issues.whats_wrong: The process-exit hook returns immediately and leaves GETs running.
issues.why_it_matters: During an update, in-flight partner calls are cut off with no drain.
how_to_fix: Track in-flight requests and wait (with a deadline) in shutdown before return.
acceptance_criteria: shutdown waits for in-flight work or cancels it on a stated deadline.
